name: data-table
title: Data table
docs: Raster leaves are StyleX. Compile them with @stylexjs/babel-plugin (Vite: @stylexjs/unplugin, Next: @stylexjs/nextjs-plugin). If you would rather not run a compiler, import @noorddev/raster-react instead: it ships precompiled with one stylesheet.

use: Rows from data with sortable columns and an empty state.
render for cells that are not plain values; sortValue for custom sort keys.
avoid: Pagination, selection, or editing; compose those around it.

keyboard.does: Sorts ascending, then descending, then clears

a11y: Sortable headers hold a native <button>; the <th> carries aria-sort while sorted.
The empty state is plain text under the table.
